title: Higher Čech derived functors via Galois theory
summary: We explore sufficient conditions for the higher Čech derived functors of a Birkhoff reflector to agree with its ordinary, Barr-Beck comonadic homology. Using categorical Galois theory together with a spectral-sequence argument, we prove that this is the case for the reflector from any semi-abelian variety onto a subvariety: for every $n\geq 1$, the $n$th Čech derived functor of the reflector coincides with its $(n+1)$st comonadic homology object. More generally, the comparison holds for any Birkhoff reflector of a semi-abelian category equipped with a comonad satisfying Quillen's conditions.
